1  NC: 2023:KHC:41460  MFA No. 6962 of 2019 PETITION OF THE APPELLANT BY AWARDING COMPENSATION AS PRAYED IN THE CLAIM PETITION ETC,
 THIS APPEAL, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY, THE COURT DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 JUDGMENT
When this matter came up on 16.11.2023 before this Court, there was no representation on behalf of the appellant.
Hence this court has directed to list the same for dismissal on 17.11.2023.
The matter is listed today, in the forenoon as well as in the afternoon, there is no representation on either side.
2. Accordingly, the appeal is dismissed for non- prosecution.

SD/-
